sn_aia_skill_metadata.description: Gives a people manager a prioritised team brief for this week: overdue and due-soon follow-up actions, manager support requests waiting for approval, upcoming birthdays and work anniversaries, missing HR information and journeys at risk. Use when a manager asks what to focus on, what is overdue, what needs their attention, or for a team brief or team summary. Also raises a manager support request (onboarding, offboarding, role change, learning plan, performance support) for a team member when the manager asks to raise, create or submit a request. Also handles any request to approve, reject, close, cancel or update a manager support request (MSR number such as MSR0001046) or its approval, and explains that this must be done by the approver.
sn_aia_skill_metadata.name: Manager Team Brief Assistant
